individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows representative fluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
The JC-1 and anti-HMGB1 bar charts show mean +/- error bars (n=20) but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a quantitative plot.
The SDH and COX signal-intensity bar charts show group means with error bars and sample sizes (N) but no individual data points are plotted.
Panel E shows FACS histogram line plots (cell number vs TMRM intensity) for individual replicate experiments; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
